searchText: The Pectra upgrade includes EIP-7702 which introduces a new transaction type: 0x04. Can anyone give me an example of such a transaction? I cannot find one on the mekong testnet explorer. EIP-7702: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/master/EIPS/eip-7702.md#set-code-transaction Mekong testnet explorer: https://explorer.mekong.ethpandaops.io/txs Besides, how do I construct such a transaction myself? You can follow the guide here to use viem to send a 0x04 transaction: https://viem.sh/experimental/eip7702/sending-transactions thank you very much!
